paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: This paper constrains dark matter decay rate (lambda ~ 1e-32 s^-1) and annihilation cross section (<sigma v> ~ 1e-30 cm^3/s) via a radio line search, NOT a standard axion-photon coupling g_agamma. The y-axis of the exclusion plots is decay rate [s^-1] or cross-section [cm^3 s^-1], which do not map cleanly onto any of the available coupling_type enums. The hint of AxionPhoton is not directly supported since limits are presented model-independently as lambda and <sigma v>, not g_agamma. No coupling-vs-mass data in the required units is extractable. Frequency range 1020-2700 MHz corresponds to photon energies ~8.4e-6 to ~1.1e-5 eV (DM mass twice that for decay). NFW local density 0.471 GeV/cm^3 (Burkert 0.487) noted. | read-vote N=2: ct=None (2/2); no consensus curve, took most-points
